name: Anjoy Foods Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Anjoy Foods Group Co., Ltd., founded in 2001 and based in Xiamen, researches, processes, produces and sells quick-frozen food in China. Its range includes stuffed meatballs and fish tofu under the Anjoy brand, prepared dishes like crayfish and egg dumplings, frozen flour and rice goods such as shumai and steamed buns, baked goods, and hot pot and barbecue items. Channels include distributors, institutional buyers, e-commerce and supermarkets.
